f_gap.name: GLOBAL_COVERAGE
f_gap.problem: The number of unique hypotheses across the RAFAELIA ecosystem is not canonically counted.
f_gap.closure_condition: Enumerate candidate hypothesis-bearing sources across Drive and GitHub, record source coverage, and produce a deduplicated unique count with unresolved coverage explicitly listed.

f_gap.name: CANONICAL_IDENTITY_AND_DEDUP
f_gap.problem: No single cross-domain hypothesis identity key is yet proven to cover all repositories and Drive material.
f_gap.closure_condition: Assign stable hypothesis_id and deduplicate using normalized statement, domain, variables, assumptions, provenance anchors and semantic equivalence review.

f_gap.name: CLASSIFICATION_HARMONIZATION
f_gap.problem: M0-M4 is defined for mathematical novelty but empirical, computational, cosmological and symbolic claims need compatible typed statuses.
f_gap.closure_condition: Define typed classes for mathematical, empirical, computational and symbolic propositions while preserving M0-M4 for mathematical novelty.

f_gap.name: EVIDENCE_LINKAGE
f_gap.problem: Not every hypothesis is linked to exact implementation, execution, receipt, dataset, environment and negative evidence.
f_gap.closure_condition: Every active hypothesis has zero or more evidence edges with provider/path/hash/run/receipt metadata; missing edges remain TOKEN_VAZIO.

f_gap.name: PRIOR_ART_AND_GENEALOGY
f_gap.problem: Surviving candidates cannot advance to M3/M4 without systematic prior-art and genealogy work.
f_gap.closure_condition: For each M2 candidate, record closest known constructions, differences, search strategy, dated sources and unresolved equivalence risks.

f_gap.name: EXECUTION_AND_FALSIFICATION
f_gap.problem: Some propositions have formal text or code but lack reproducible execution, adversarial tests, null models or physical-device validation.
f_gap.closure_condition: Attach reproducible tests and explicit failure criteria; distinguish container, CI and physical Termux evidence.

f_gap.name: TERMINALITY_AND_GLOBAL_COUNT
f_gap.problem: There is no global terminality certificate showing that the hypothesis-bearing source universe has been sufficiently scanned for a closed count.
f_gap.closure_condition: Publish a coverage matrix and terminality receipt that states scanned scope, exclusions, remaining TOKEN_VAZIO sources and the resulting unique hypothesis count.
